questions.stem: Which Warlock curse is gone in Forever?
questions.explanation: Curse of Shadows is gone because Curse of the Elements now covers every magic school. Curse of Agony is still there, as a Bane.

questions.stem: Which Warlock weapon imbue adds Fire damage and spell crit?
questions.explanation: Firestone adds Fire damage and spell crit; Spellstone adds Shadow damage and spell haste. Both stack with Wizard Oil.

questions.stem: What does Life Tap scale with in Forever?
questions.explanation: Life Tap scales with Spirit. Spell healing is what Voidwalker Sacrifice scales with (10% of it).

questions.stem: Which of these Classic Demonology talents is no longer in the tree?
questions.explanation: Improved Healthstone is gone. Improved Voidwalker and Improved Sayaad are the only Warlock talents left unchanged from Classic 1.12.

questions.stem: Which Destruction talent is new in Forever?
questions.explanation: Incinerate is one of five new Destruction talents. Devastation and Emberstorm are Classic talents that are gone.

questions.stem: Which demon does the quest 'What Is Love?' in Stormwind give you?
questions.explanation: 'What Is Love?' is the Incubus quest. The Succubus comes from 'Devourer of Souls' and the Felhunter from 'Seeking Strahad'.

questions.stem: Who does Ritual of Summoning need?
questions.explanation: Ritual of Summoning needs you plus two helpers. Four party members is the Classic 1.12 requirement for Ritual of Doom.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, who gives the level-50 Infernal quest?
questions.explanation: In Classic, Niby the Almighty in Felwood gives the Infernal quest; Strahad Farsan in Ratchet gives the Felsteed quest. Neither is confirmed for Forever yet.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, who does Ritual of Doom need?
questions.explanation: In Classic, Ritual of Doom uses a Demonic Figurine and needs you plus four party members. Two helpers is Ritual of Summoning. How Forever unlocks it is unverified.

questions.stem: What does the Human racial give in the 26 Oct notes?
questions.explanation: Humans get +10% Spirit, which feeds Life Tap. +1% hit is the Dwarf's Artisan's Precision and +2% haste the Skyborne's Wind-Blessed.

questions.stem: Which racial makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger for 8 sec?
questions.explanation: That is the Gnome's Eureka!. Ruthless is the Human crit racial and Wind-Blessed the Skyborne haste racial.

questions.stem: Which Warlock tool heals outside the potion cooldown?
questions.explanation: Healthstones heal outside the potion cooldown. The Soulstone gives a combat resurrection.

questions.stem: Which launch raid is the 40-player raid?
questions.explanation: Barrow Deeps is for 10 players, Hyjal Summit for 20 and Onyxia's Lair for 40. Raid unlock date for all three: 9 December 2026.

questions.stem: In the current talent data, which spells does Improved Drains strengthen?
choices: Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana
Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack
questions.explanation: Improved Drains covers Drain Life, Drain Soul and Drain Mana. The list with Wrack belongs to Fel Concentration, which protects those spells from pushback.

questions.stem: How long does a Wrack channel last?
questions.explanation: Wrack channels for 6 sec and deals its Shadow damage every 1 sec.

questions.stem: While you channel Wrack, how much faster do your Siphon Life, Corruption and Bane of Agony deal their periodic damage?
questions.explanation: They deal their periodic damage 100% faster while you channel. Older guides said Wrack added 10% to your other DoTs; the current data replaced that. 2% is Improved Corruption's damage bonus per rank.

questions.stem: Nightfall's Shadow Trance makes your next cast of which spell instant?
questions.explanation: Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life and Wrack can start a Shadow Trance, and the Trance removes the cast time of your next Shadow Bolt.

questions.stem: Without Amplify Curse, how much does Curse of Exhaustion slow its target?
questions.explanation: Curse of Exhaustion reduces movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Amplify Curse makes it 20% stronger; its 50% applies to Curse of Weakness and Bane of Agony.

questions.stem: You have Soul Siphon at 3/3, and your Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony are all on the target. What is the most Soul Siphon adds to your Drain Life?
questions.explanation: At 3/3 Soul Siphon adds 12% per effect, up to a maximum of 36%. 24% is the cap at rank 2.

questions.stem: Which talent is the Warlock's source of spell hit?
questions.explanation: Suppression gives up to 5% hit with all spells. Malevolence adds Shadow crit and Pandemic raises the crit damage bonus of DoTs and drains.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, how much spell hit did you need against bosses three levels higher?
questions.explanation: In Classic 1.12 it was 16% against bosses three levels higher and 3% against same-level targets. No Forever value has been published.

questions.stem: Which profession makes healing potions in Forever?
questions.explanation: Healing potions moved to First Aid. Alchemists still brew flasks, at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object.

questions.stem: In the datamined files, how much does the Major Healthstone heal?
questions.explanation: The files show 1,440, as if fully talented. 1,200 is the untalented Classic value. Blizzard has not confirmed the Forever number.

questions.stem: Which demon do you sacrifice with Demonic Sacrifice for more Shadow damage?
questions.explanation: The Imp gives 15% more Shadow damage. The Succubus or Incubus gives Fire damage, the Voidwalker mana and the Felhunter health.

questions.stem: You cast Amplify Curse, then Curse of Exhaustion on a Rogue. How much stronger does Amplify Curse make the slow?
questions.explanation: Amplify Curse raises your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. The 50% is for Curse of Weakness and Bane of Agony, and 30% is the curse's own slow.

questions.stem: How much does Fel Domination cut your next summon's casting time?
questions.explanation: Fel Domination cuts it by 5.5 sec and the mana cost by 50%. 2 sec and 4 sec are Master Summoner at rank 1 and rank 2.

questions.stem: Which kind of Demonic Brand damage carries high threat?
questions.explanation: The brand deals Fire or Shadow damage depending on the pet, and only Shadow damage has high threat.

questions.stem: Below what health must the enemy be for Decimation's Soul Fire bonus?
questions.explanation: Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health triggers it. 45% is the Soul Fire cooldown cut and 20% the cast time cut at rank 1.

questions.stem: With Master Demonologist, which demon gives you more Fire damage?
questions.explanation: The Imp gives Fire damage, the Succubus or Incubus Shadow damage and the Voidwalker less Physical damage taken. Demonic Sacrifice pairs the other way round.

questions.stem: With Demonic Pact, what still cancels your Demonic Sacrifice effect?
questions.explanation: Demonic Pact stops a different demon from cancelling the effect; resummoning the pet you sacrificed still cancels it.

questions.stem: Which tree holds the Warlock's hit talent?
questions.explanation: Suppression, on Affliction row 1, is the hit talent. Neither Demonology nor Destruction has one.

questions.stem: Which stone adds Fire damage and spell crit?
questions.explanation: Firestone adds Fire damage and spell crit, Spellstone Shadow damage and spell haste; both stack with Wizard Oil.

questions.stem: Which demon brings Spell Lock and Devour Magic?
questions.explanation: The Felhunter has Spell Lock and Devour Magic; the Imp brings Blood Pact and Fire Shield.

questions.stem: With Soul Link active, how much of the damage you take goes to your demon?
questions.explanation: 30% of the damage you take goes to the demon. The 3% is the extra damage you and the demon both deal.

questions.stem: With one point in Aftermath, what chance does Conflagrate have to Daze the target?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 gives a 20% chance to Daze. The 10% is Immolate's extra initial damage, and the Daze slows by 50%.

questions.stem: Incinerate deals extra damage to a target afflicted by which of your spells?
questions.explanation: Incinerate deals 25% more to a target afflicted by Immolate. Bane of Havoc is the talent Incinerate requires.

questions.stem: With Shadow and Flame at 5/5, what chance does Conflagrate have not to consume Immolate?
questions.explanation: At 5/5 Conflagrate never consumes Immolate. At rank 1 the chance is 20%.

questions.stem: At rank 1, what chance does Pyroclasm give Soul Fire to stun the target?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 gives 13% and rank 2 26%, for a 3 sec stun.

questions.stem: With Bane at 5/5, how much faster is Soul Fire's cast?
questions.explanation: Bane at 5/5 cuts Soul Fire by 2 sec and Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Incinerate by 0.5 sec. 0.4 sec is Soul Fire at rank 1.

questions.stem: How much extra damage does Incinerate deal to a target afflicted by Immolate?
questions.explanation: Incinerate deals 25% more to an Immolated target. 3% and 10% are Agonizing Flames' damage bonus for one point and at 3/3.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, what share of spells always missed?
questions.explanation: In Classic 1.12, 1% of spells always missed, and casters needed 16% spell hit against bosses three levels higher.

questions.stem: Which stone matches Shadow Bolt?
questions.explanation: Spellstone adds Shadow damage and spell haste, which suits Shadow Bolt. Firestone suits Incinerate and Conflagrate.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, how much fire resistance does the Onyxia Scale Cloak give?
questions.explanation: In Classic 1.12 the Onyxia Scale Cloak gives +16; the Drakefire Amulet, Juju Ember and the cloak enchant give +15 each.

questions.stem: What share of the damage you deal to other targets does your Bane of Havoc target also take?
questions.explanation: The Bane of Havoc target takes 15% of the damage you deal to other targets. 3% is Cataclysm's mana saving for one point and 10% its saving at 3/3.

questions.stem: At Aftermath 5/5, what chance does Conflagrate have to Daze the target?
questions.explanation: At 5/5 every Conflagrate Dazes the target. Rank 1 gives 20% and rank 3 60%.
